source.title: Webster townwide, Massachusetts — MassGIS 2025 aerial texture
source.uv_convention: u west-to-east, v south-to-north; image spans the full Web Mercator tile rectangle
source.world_pixel_uv_formula: u=(global_pixel_x-x0*256)/width; v=1-(global_pixel_y-y0*256)/height; global pixels measured from tile outer edges, not pixel centres
source.attribution: MassGIS and NV5 Geospatial; funding by MassDOT, Massachusetts State 911 Department, and EOTSS.
source.use_and_restrictions: MassGIS states no restrictions apply and the imagery is available for public use and distribution. Acknowledgement is appreciated.
source.acquisition: Spring 2025; statewide collection March 18–April 23, 2025; this mosaic does not resolve individual exposure dates.
limitations: Ground sampling of this z17 web cache is approximately 89 cm at Webster, coarser than native 15 cm acquisition.
Mosaic preserves the cached pixel dimensions; JPEG output adds lossy compression.
Aerial imagery does not supply vertical facade textures or measured building geometry.
Coordinates were transformed through installed PROJ pipelines without independent survey verification.
Imagery may show buildings, trees, vehicles and shadows above the terrain; draping imagery cannot reconstruct their geometry.

basis: Viewed official exterior: white walls, red deck bands, blue upper canopy, arched windows, paired black stacks with red bands/gold crowns, white stern spokes and red paddles. Two decks and twin stern wheels are officially described. Length/position/axis derived approximately from spring2025 aerial; beam, height, window count, small trim and exact current berth are authored. This is a stationary late-summer game interpretation, not live vessel tracking.
